CSC Service Types Definitions

group CSCS_TYPES_DEFs

Enums

enum T_CSCS_PARAM_TYPE

CSC Service parameter type.

Values:

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_CSCS_FEATURE

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter to set CSC Feature characteristic value.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_INC_FLAG

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get CSC Measurement characteristic Flags field value.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_WHEEL_REVOL

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get Cumulative Wheel Revolutions field value in the Wheel Revolution Data field of CSC Measurement characteristic.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_WHEEL_EVT_TIME

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get Last Wheel Event Time field value in the Wheel Revolution Data field of CSC Measurement characteristic.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_CRANK_REVOL

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get Cumulative Crank Revolutions field value in the Crank Revolution Data field of CSC Measurement characteristic.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_CRANK_EVT_TIME

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get Last Crank Event Time field value in the Crank Revolution Data field of CSC Measurement characteristic.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_CTL_PNT_PROG_CLR

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter to clear SC Control Point characteristic progress flag.

enumerator CSCS_PARAM_SENSOR_LOC

Parameter type for cscs_set_parameter or cscs_get_parameter to set or get Sensor Location characteristic value.

struct T_CSCS_CONTROL_POINT
